children: Despite a federal court order granting access, White House reporters from Politico, MS Now
have had their press passes confiscated by Secret Service agents on Thursday and barred from entering the White House complex.
U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly granted a temporary restraining order
granting access to CNN, Politico, and MS Now for at least two weeks while the administration’s prior ban is litigated.
The removal of reporters’ press badges was likely done without “constitutionally adequate due process,” Judge Timothy Kelly said in a ruling issued early Thursday, as per reports.

On Saturday, President Trump denied reporters from the three news organizations access to the White House and removed CNN from its duties as White House pool representative for TV networks for what the president considers negative coverage. The three outlets subsequently filed a legal challenge to the ban, claiming the order violates the First Amendment.
The White House ban led the other major news outlets to suspend pool coverage of the White House in solidarity with their colleagues.

title: White House defies court order, bars reporters from CNN, Politico, MS Now
